description: Middleware functions for session-based authentication and role authorization in a Node.js application. Implements token validation, session store access, and role guarding.

methods.name: requireAuth(req, res, next)
methods.description: Middleware function that checks for a valid session token in request headers, verifies the session, and attaches user info to request object.

methods.name: requireRole(role)
methods.description: Factory function that returns middleware to enforce role-based access control ('agent' or 'admin') based on the authenticated user's role.
